pick.name: Superpowers (obra)
pick.what: Mandatory brainstorm -> worktree -> plan -> subagent execution -> red/green TDD -> review -> finish-branch
pick.why: Most adopted methodology (~307k stars), in official marketplace, MIT, very active

alts.name: feature-dev (official)
alts.what: Guided feature workflow with explorer/architect/reviewer agents

alts.name: GitHub Spec Kit
alts.what: Spec -> plan -> tasks -> implement pipeline, agent-agnostic
alts.why: Best for greenfield products or client specs you must hand over

candidates.name: GSD (get-shit-done)
candidates.verdict: original repo archived; moved to open-gsd/gsd-core

decision: Superpowers enforces the TDD + review gates a solo founder has no colleague to enforce, and is the most maintained. Its gates slow small tasks; use plain plan mode for one-file fixes and Spec Kit when a client wants a written spec.
details: Disable overlapping planners (claude-mem make-plan/do, orchestration skill) to avoid conflicting instructions.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
